text: <style="accent-gn">Transforms into</style> Boss: Inferno Ogre to unleash a forward fiery breath that deals <style="physical">Attack DMG</style> and <linktext=3000><style="ItemQuality_5">interrupts</style></linktext> affected targets. Concurrently, applies <style="accent-gn">Healing</style> to you, and <style="accent-gn">100%</style> excess healing is converted into a <style="accent-gn">Shield</style> lasting <style="accent-gn">20s</style>. The transformed form reduces DMG taken by <style="accent-gn">50%</style>.

<style="accent-gn">Summons Boss</style>: Tempest Ogre and channels the power of thunder to generate a vortex, continuously pulling in enemies near the target and dealing AoE <style="magic">Magic DMG</style> when the duration ends.

Transforms into Boss: Brigand Leader and summons a blazing giant axe, increasing the party's ATK within range for a period and granting yourself additional ATK boost.
(This effect cannot stack and only one can be active at a time.)

Summons Elite: Muku Warrior to leap forward and deliver a powerful strike, dealing AoE Attack DMG. This attack is guaranteed to Crit.
Upon the skill cast, your Crit and Crit DMG are increased for a period.

Summons Elite: Boarrier Tyrant to charge forward with tusks for 3s. Deals Attack DMG and knocks enemies airborne during the charge. Boarrier tusks tear through flesh, inflicting 100% Wound on enemies hit for 15s.
Upon the skill cast, the DMG dealt and healing of your Special Attack are increased for a period.

Summons Boss: Frost Ogre to execute a spinning attack with an ice hammer, resulting in Attack DMG and freezing all targets on hit.
Upon the skill cast, your Resilience Break Bonus is increased for a period.

Transforms into Elite: Inferno Goblin Mage and summons meteors from the sky, dealing Magic DMG and interrupting the target's actions.
Upon the skill cast, your Intellect is increased for a period.

Summons Boss: Muku King to channel Forest Energy, healing up to 10 allies over time and dispelling debuffs.
Upon the skill cast, your healing received is increased for a period.

<style="accent-gn">Summons Elite</style>: Void Ogre, roars in place, and fires 6 whirlwind-like Void Projectiles at the target, dealing <style="physical">Attack DMG</style>. Inflicts Void Corruption Decay on the target for <style="accent-gn">10s</style>, dealing <style="magic">Magic DMG</style> per second, up to <style="accent-gn">5</style> stacks. <style="accent-gn">100%</style> of the DMG dealt over time is converted into your HP.

Summons Tatta to grant Battle Will to the entire team, preventing all allies from being defeated and ensuring their HP does not fall below a certain threshold for a period of time.
Exhausted: Cannot be affected by the same type of effect within 60s (Exhausted effects are enhanced in party dungeons of Nightmare mode).

Transforms into Elite: Shadow Captain to launch an Electro Bomb at the designated target, dealing AoE Attack DMG and interrupting the target's actions.
Upon the skill cast, the DMG dealt and healing of your Expertise Skill are increased for a period.

Summons Elite: Goblin Guard to perform multiple sword energy attacks forward, dealing Attack DMG. Sword energy hits will reduce the target's Armor.
(The effect cannot stack, and only one effect of the same type will be effective.)
Upon the skill cast, your Block DMG reduction is increased for a period.

Summons Elite: Goblin Warrior to shoot in a fan-shaped area in front, dealing Attack DMG.
Upon the skill cast, your Luck and Lucky Strike Chance are increased for a period.

<style="accent-gn">Summons Elite</style>: Shadow Commander to execute a forward flurry of slashes, inflicting <style="physical">Attack DMG</style> and <linktext=3000><style="ItemQuality_5">interrupting</style></linktext> the target's actions. All Heavy Slash charges are consumed in the process to significantly amplify the DMG inflicted.

<style="accent-gn">Summons</style> Airona. After a brief cast, revives up to <style="accent-gn">4</style> nearby teammates. <style="accent-gn">Weakness: Cannot be affected by the same type of effect within 60s (Weakness effects are enhanced in party dungeons of Nightmare mode).</style>

Summons Tina to channel the power of time, reducing the Skill CDs of yourself and up to 10 surrounding allies for a certain period.
(Cannot be affected by the same type of effect within 60s.)

<style="accent-gn">Summons</style> Olvera to shuttle back and forth in a forward direction, drawing in enemies encountered along the path, dealing <style="physical">Attack DMG</style>, and <linktext=3000><style="ItemQuality_5">interrupting</style></linktext> their actions. When dealing DMG, there is a chance to inflict Seed of Lightning on the targets for <style="accent-gn">10s</style>. Dealing DMG to targets with Seed of Lightning will cause an explosion (CD: <style="accent-gn">2s</style>), dealing <style="magic">Magic DMG</style>. Any target with Seed of Lightning defeated will reduce CD time by <style="accent-gn">20s</style>.

Summons Boss: Muku Chief to slam the ground around, dealing AoE Attack DMG. Holds 2 charges.
Upon the skill cast, your Crit and Crit DMG are increased for a period.

Transforms into Elite: Mighty Colossus to charge and deal Attack DMG. The longer you charge, the greater the effect on Resilience breaking. Each stack increases the Resilience Break done by 50%. (3 stacks at Tier 3 and 6 stacks at Tier 5.)
Upon the skill cast, your Resilience Break Bonus is increased for a period.

Summons Boss: Storm Goblin King to release a meteor shower at the target, dealing Magic DMG. Upon the skill cast, your Luck and DMG dealt and healing of Luck effects are increased for a period.
Tier 5: While active, trigger all unlocked passive Luck effects from your Plains Battle Imagines.

Summons Elite: Jungle Goblin Warrior and roars.
Casts the skill, temporarily boosting Strength, empowering the next attack to deal bonus Attack DMG in a limited area, and interrupting the target's actions.

Summons Elite: Muku Scout to chase the target, dealing Attack DMG.
Upon the skill cast, immediately gains full passive effects, and the stack count is doubled within 20s.
<style="accent-gn">Transforms into Elite</style>: Void Arachnocrab, and gains <style="accent-gn">Invincibility</style> for <style="accent-gn">5s</style>.

<style="accent-gn">Transforms into Elite</style>: Brigand Guard Captain to grant Earth Shield, recovering a percentage of lost HP when you are attacked, up to <style="accent-gn">9</style> times. During this, your <style="accent-gn">Endurance</style> is increased.

Summons Elite: Brigand Scout Leader to execute continuous attacks on the designated target, dealing Attack DMG and interrupting their actions.
Upon the skill cast, your Agility is increased for a period.

Transforms into Boss: Golden Juggernaut, granting yourself and 10 allies Shield. When dealing DMG, the shielded targets generate Thunderstrike (CD: 0.5s), and the DMG dealt depends on the friendly ATK.
(This effect cannot stack and only one will be effective.)

Summons Elite: Lizardman Mage to conjure the Water of Silence at the target's location, dealing Magic DMG and inflicting Slow.
Upon the skill cast, your Ice Bonus is increased for a period.

Summons Elite: Lizardman Hunter to chant briefly, dealing Magic DMG.
Upon the skill cast, your Luck and Lucky Strike Chance are increased for a period.

<style="accent-gn">Summons Boss</style>: Phantom Arachnocrab and transforms into a cocoon. Following a brief delay, the cocoon bursts, dealing <style="physical">Attack DMG</style> and <linktext=3000><style="ItemQuality_5">interrupting</style></linktext> the actions of the affected target. Your <style="accent-gn">Mastery</style> is increased for a period.

Summons Elite: Great Warhog to release a Lightning Orb forward, dealing Attack DMG.
Upon the skill cast, your Light Bonus is increased for a period.

Summons Elite: Storm Goblin Warrior to continuously release Whirlwind Slash, dealing Attack DMG and pulling in all surrounding units.
Upon the skill cast, your Wind Bonus is increased for a period.
<style="accent-gn">Transforms into Elite</style>: Void Bzzar for a period of time, during which you can release stings and projectiles.

Summons Boss: Venobzzar Incubator to continuously attack surrounding units, dealing Attack DMG. Each attack inflicts Vulnerability on the target, and your DMG dealt to the target is increased.
(This effect cannot stack and only one will be effective.)

<style="accent-gn">Summons Boss</style>: Iron Fang to deliver AoE <style="physical">Attack DMG</style> to nearby enemies, inflicting a <style="accent-gn">100%</style> <linktext=3004><style="ItemQuality_5">Wound</style></linktext> on all affected targets for <style="accent-gn">15s</style>.

<style="accent-gn">Summons Boss</style>: Celestial Flier to charge forward, dealing Ice <style="physical">Attack DMG</style> and <linktext=3000><style="ItemQuality_5">interrupting</style></linktext> the targets' actions. After casting, your <style="accent-gn">Haste</style> is increased for a period of time.

<style="accent-gn">Summons Boss</style>: Lizardman King to deal Ice <style="physical">Attack DMG</style> to nearby enemies and <linktext=3001><style="ItemQuality_5">Silence</style></linktext> them for <style="accent-gn">10s</style>.

Resonates with the power of Boss: Goblin King, summoning 1–3 goblins at random to cast skills.
Always summons 1 from Elite: Goblin Guard or Elite: Goblin Warrior.
Has a chance to additionally summon 1 Elite: Jungle Goblin Warrior.
Has a chance to summon 1 from Elite: Storm Goblin Axe or Boss: Storm Goblin King. Has a 30% chance to summon the Boss.

Summons Elite: Muku Vanguard to charge forward, dealing Attack DMG.
Upon the skill cast, your Thunder Bonus is increased for a period.

Summons Rorola, resonating with the power of ancestors to gain a damage boost for some time. Also, every 10 hits on targets grant an additional damage boost, stacking up to 5 times. Once the cap is reached, subsequent hits extend the duration of the additional boost (the duration of the Base DMG boost does not extend). Each extension adds 3s, with a maximum of 5 extensions. At the same time, grants the Life Steal effect, restoring HP equal to a portion of damage dealt (the duration can extend).
This skill holds 2 charges.

Transforms into Dorothy, replacing basic attack modules and gaining Artisan's Power.
Passive: Dealing damage has a 40% chance to trigger Chain Lightning (trigger interval: at least 0.5s).
① Charges and fires a powerful shot at the target, dealing Attack DMG. Each additional charge increases the damage by 150%.
② Leaps into the air and launches a Thunderstorm Bolt at the target, dealing Attack DMG and creating a Thunderstorm Zone at the target for 7s. Thunderstorm Zone deals Attack DMG per second to enemies within and slows them.
③ Continuously unleashes Thunder Tracers, dealing Attack DMG and inflicting Paralysis on hit.
④ Fires an Oblivion Bomb, which explodes after traveling a distance or upon impact, dealing Attack DMG.

Summons Boyce to create a field of frost by concentrating ice power, dealing Ice Magic DMG.
After casting, your ATK is increased for a period of time. Each cast of a Special Attack grants an additional increase, stacking up to 5 times. At max stacks, gain a bonus to Attack SPD and Casting SPD. Performing a Special Attack extends this bonus's duration by 3s, up to a max of 5 times (The ATK bonus's duration is not affected).
This skill holds 2 charges.

Summons Fafala to create a field.
You and allies within the field gain Final DMG Reduction and Super Armor. When you deal damage from inside the field, inflict bonus damage based on a percentage of your DEF (can trigger at most once every 1s). When you take damage, reduce the CD of this Skill by 1s (can trigger at most once every 2s).
[This effect does not stack. Only one instance of this effect can be active at a time.

Summons Boss: Blackstone Captain to ignite flames centered on yourself, dealing Fire Attack DMG.
After casting, your Attack SPD and Casting SPD are increased for a period of time.

Summons Boss: Goblin Chief to briefly charge up and unleash a forward blade wave that deals Attack DMG.
After casting, your Expertise Skill's DMG and healing are increased for a period of time. During this time, dealing damage with an Expertise Skill reduces the CD of this Skill by 0.3s (can trigger at most once every 1s).

Summons Boss: Crimson Foxen to spin and pounce on the target, dealing Attack DMG.
After casting, your Companion ATK is increased for a period of time.

Summons Boss: Cabbage Kingpin to briefly charge up and slam the ground with a hammer, dealing Attack DMG.
After casting, your passive effect is locked to the displayed sigil for 20s, and its effect is increased by 100%-150%.

Summons Boss: Flamehorn to repeatedly ram the target with its horns, dealing Attack DMG.
Grants a Luck effect: Triggering a Lucky Strike causes an explosion at the target's location, dealing Magic DMG (cooldown: 0.1s), and immediately grants the Absolute Luck effect. For the duration, Absolute Luck's cooldown becomes 5s.

Summons Boss: Basilisk to spin toward the target, dealing Attack DMG.
After casting, grants an All-Element Bonus to you and up to 10 nearby allies (prioritizing teammates) for a period of time.
(Cannot be affected by the same type of effect within 60s)

Summons Elite: Bluespine Lizard to breathe frost forward, dealing Attack DMG to targets in the area.
After casting, increases Versatility for a period of time.

Summons Elite: Blackstone Commander to call down lightning from the sky, dealing Magic DMG.
For a period of time after the skill is cast, when you deal damage, you will also deal additional Attack DMG to the target equal to a percentage of your Armor (can trigger at most once every 1s).

<style="accent-gn">Transforms into</style> Elite: Blackstone Vanguard to perform a spinning attack that deals Fire <style="physical">Attack DMG</style>. Every stack of Blade Intent allows for an additional spin (up to <style="accent-gn">15</style> stacks). This damage benefits from all types of elemental bonuses and is not affected by passive effects.

<style="accent-gn">Summons</style> Elite: Goblin Trickster to channel for a long time before dealing massive AoE <style="magic">Magic DMG</style>. (This skill damages enemies and up to <style="accent-gn">20</style> allies!)

Summons Elite: Goblin Shaman to briefly channel before summoning an exploding magic orb. The explosion deals Magic DMG to targets in the area and heals up to 10 nearby allies (prioritizing teammates).
After casting, for 20s, you deal damage every 2s to the surrounding area equal to 50% of the self-healing from your Class Skills.

Summons Elite: Blackfire Foxen to pounce on, bite, and then swipe its tail at the target, dealing Attack DMG.
After casting, your Mastery is increased for a period of time.

Summons Elite: Gloomy Cabbage to briefly charge up and swing a greatsword, dealing Attack DMG to targets in the area.
After casting, your Crit and Crit DMG are increased for a while (the values fluctuate based on the Cabbage sigil).

<style="accent-gn">Summons</style> Elite: Ruthless Cabbage to randomly call down <style="accent-gn">1-3</style> bolts of simulated lightning, dealing <style="magic">Magic DMG</style> to targets in the area.

Summons Elite: Emerald Caprahorn to fire two consecutive projectiles, dealing Attack DMG to targets in the area.
After casting, your Haste is increased for a period of time.

Summons Denvel to attract nearby monsters and deal Attack DMG.
After casting, grants a temporary enhancement: the user takes damage equal to 0.1% of Max HP every 0.2s and gains a DMG boost, with an additional boost for every 100,000 Max HP (Total base and extra DMG boost is capped, and the Max HP requirement is adjusted each season).
This skill holds 2 charges.

Summons Igoreus to deal Attack DMG. Holds 2 charges.
After casting, your Crit is temporarily increased. Any base Crit Rate exceeding 60% is converted into a Crit DMG boost at a set ratio.

Summons Plague Nappo. The Nappo's attack method and skill effects change based on the type of skill cast previously.
If cast directly or after a Special Attack, summons Stormblade Nappo to deal AoE Attack DMG once, and reduces the current Resonance Skill's CD by 81.25%.
If cast after an Expertise Skill, summons Marksman Nappo to deal Attack DMG to a single target, and reduces the current Resonance Skill's CD by 68.75%.
If cast after an Ultimate, summons Wind Knight Nappo to deal Attack DMG once, reduces the current Resonance Skill's CD by 25%, and temporarily increases your DMG.
If cast after another Resonance Skill, summons Beat Performer Nappo to reduce the CD of the previously cast Resonance Skill (excluding this one).

Summons Kartgriff to deal Magic DMG.
After casting, temporarily grants a Main Stats and Healing Received boost to you and up to 10 nearby allies (prioritizing teammates).
(Cannot be affected by the same type of effect within 60s.)

Summons Boss: Predator Spider to deal Attack DMG.
After casting, your passive ATK bonus is temporarily enhanced according to your Mastery Percentage. Every 5% Mastery grants extra ATK for each passive stack (up to a max limit).

Summons Boss: Rebel King to deal Attack DMG.
After casting, temporarily grants full passive stacks, with the effect multiplied by 2.

Summons Boss: Void Watcher, dealing Magic DMG and occupying an area for a period of time.
You and your teammates within the area gain increased ATK, Attack SPD, and Casting SPD. The effect on yourself is multiplied by 2.5.
(Does not stack; only one of the same effect may be active.)

Summons Boss: Ridge Fang to deal Attack DMG.
After casting, instantly resets Survival Instinct CD. You remain Invigorated temporarily, and your Armor and Max HP are increased.

Summons Boss: Bloodthirsty Furball to deal Attack DMG.
For a period of time after casting, every time your Class Skills and Luck effect deal damage, they add extra damage on top of the skill's base value, equal to a certain percentage of your ATK.

Summons Elite: Killer Arachnocrab to deal Attack DMG.
After casting, you gain full passive stacks for a period of time, during which they do not decrease.

Summons Elite: Verdant Fang to deal Attack DMG.
For a period of time after casting, each Class Skill used reduces your remaining Ultimate CD (triggers up to once every 1s).

Summons Elite: Man-Eating Furball to deal Attack DMG.
After casting, your Fire Bonus is temporarily increased.

Summons Elite: Dogorman, dealing Attack DMG equal to a percentage of your HP.
After casting, your HP is also temporarily increased.

Summons Elite: Sanctuary Eye to deal Attack DMG.
After casting, grants a Shield to yourself and up to 10 nearby allies for a period of time (prioritizes teammates).

Transform into Celestial Spirit Mage - Lucy, replacing your skill set while gaining Ability Conversion.
Passive: Dealing damage converts 50% of the damage dealt into healing for up to 10 nearby allies (prioritizing teammates).
1. Fleuve d'Étoiles: Manifests the Fleuve d'Étoiles and swings it continuously, dealing Light Magic DMG to targets.
2. Celestial Guardian: Harnesses the power of Celestial Spirits to grant a shield lasting 20s to up to 10 allies within range (prioritizing teammates). Simultaneously inflicts debuffs on up to 5 enemies within range, reducing ATK, applying Vulnerability, and reducing Element Resistance for 10s.
3. Aqua Metria: Draws upon the power of Aquarius to unleash waves forward, dealing Water Magic DMG to targets in their path, with an additional 50% of the damage dealt converted into healing.

Transform into Fire Dragon Slayer - Natsu, replacing your skill set while gaining Ability Conversion.
Passive: Casting skills other than an Ultimate Skill grants stacks of Dragon Flame based on the skill type. Every 10 stacks of Dragon Flame automatically converts into 1 stack of Dragon Force. Dragon Force can stack up to 5 times. Each stack of Dragon Force grants a Fire Bonus.
1. Fire Dragon's Iron Fist: Charges briefly before unleashing a blazing punch forward, dealing Fire Attack DMG and accumulating 5 stacks of Dragon Flame.
2. Fire Dragon's Wing Attack: Leaps fiercely and dashes forward, dealing Fire Attack DMG and accumulating 5 stacks of Dragon Flame.
3. Fire Dragon's Roar: Gathers the power of flames to spew a massive blast of fire forward, dealing Fire Attack DMG. If at max Dragon Force stacks, consumes all stacks of Dragon Force to gain CD reduction for Natsu's skills and a Fire Bonus. This effect persists for the duration of the current transformation and can stack up to 3 times.
